assessment.message: P7, “must converge to stable values” states a necessity without showing a calculation. Try a tiny counterexample exercise: write an English parenting prompt with the update rule x(next) = −x(current), starting at 1. Ask Astra7 to write the next four values and explain whether they settle to one value. Put your actual prompt here now; leave the calculation to your child. This tests a narrow claim about an update rule, not whether Astra7’s own training has converged.
